decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01, 02 and planning statement. Received: 17th January 2013 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - There shall be no parking of vehicles associated with the mini-cab business at 184 North Hyde Lane on Ringway (apart from the service access way to the rear of the site accessed via Ringway), Hadley Gardens and Clunbury Avenue and there shall be no picking up or dropping off of clients between the hours of 2300 and 0600 from the parade
description: Variation of condition 2 of application 00815/184/P2 to read as follows "there shall be no parking of vehicles associated with the mini-cab business at 184 North Hyde Lane on Ringway (apart from the service access way to the rear of the site accessed via Ringway), Hadley Gardens and Clunbury Avenue and there shall be no picking up or dropping off of clients between the hours of 2300 and 0600 from the parade".
